summary: Rewired Datasette startup through the ASGI lifespan. Added Datasette._startup_sequence() — a single idempotent, lock-guarded entry point (guards on both _startup_invoked and _setup_db_done) that does the immutable-database table-count precompute then invoke_startup(). __init__ now sets _setup_db_done=False and _startup_lock in both the normal and RuntimeError branches. app() dropped the local setup_db and wraps with AsgiLifespan(on_startup=[_startup_sequence], on_shutdown=[_close_on_shutdown]) then AsgiRunOnFirstRequest(on_startup=[_startup_sequence]). AsgiLifespan.__call__ catches exceptions on startup/shutdown and emits lifespan.*.failed instead of escaping; AsgiRunOnFirstRequest passes lifespan scopes through and takes _lock to re-check and serialize concurrent first requests. serve now calls ds._startup_sequence() instead of ds.invoke_startup(). Check commands pass (157 passed, 4 skipped, exit 0).
concerns: The _startup_lock and _setup_db_done are created inside __init__ after databases are added; verify no code path constructs Datasette before the lock exists in a way that would race _startup_sequence.
AsgiRunOnFirstRequest now skips its on_startup list entirely for lifespan scopes — confirm no other wrapper or test relies on it running those hooks for lifespan scope.
